title: Halting within a fixed number of steps
statement: An oracle nondeterministic Turing machine halts within $t$ steps on an input, relative to an oracle language, if every sequence of exactly $t$ nondeterministic choice bits produces a run whose final configuration has no state.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle language over its symbol alphabet
Every Boolean sequence of length exactly the step bound
